messages:
Asha (Billing): Heads-up: Stripe auto-flagged DynaAds (acct_00499) for a chargeback after a batch of refunds. Dispute id dsp_77Yy. Link: https://dashboard.stripe.com/disputes/dsp_77Yy
Marco (Risk): What triggered refunds? Merchant says it was a webhook retry loop after they migrated subscription webhooks yesterday.
Priya (Customer Success): Merchant confirmed they retried webhooks; they uploaded the migration logs and a CSV of refunds: /shared/finance/dynads/migration-refunds-2026-03-23.csv
chargeback-bot: Alert: dispute opened by cardholder for ch_7XyZ. Evidence deadline in 7 days. Suggested priority: high.
Evan (FinOps): Are the refunds already reconciled on our ledger? If we refund and a chargeback arrives, we may be double-exposed. What's the net effect?
Asha (Billing): Ledger shows refunds applied but settlement was already moved: ledger_tx_9922 shows net -$18,400 for the day. Refunds total $12,000.
Marco (Risk): Action plan: 1) Collect merchant signed cancellation requests, 2) get webhook retry logs and delivery timestamps, 3) gather original receipts and shipping/usage proof if applicable.
Priya (Customer Success): Merchant provided signed email from advertiser contact saying refunds were accidental and they want reversal. They also attached a screenshot of their webhook queue hitting 5x.
Legal Bot: Note: if evidence doesn't show cardholder authorization issue, we respond to dispute with proof of merchant-initiated refund. Need capture of refund reason codes.
Evan (FinOps): Can we put a temporary hold on DynaAds payouts while this is under review? We might recover funds if dispute resolves in our favor.
Asha (Billing): I've placed a manual hold on the next scheduled payout and added portal note: "Chargeback open dsp_77Yy; pending merchant evidence."
Marco (Risk): I'm pulling Stripe full event logs and webhook delivery traces now. ETA 2 hours.
Priya (Customer Success): I've requested the merchant to sign a formal affidavit and to confirm which refunds were duplicates vs intentional. They've agreed to send by EOD.
chargeback-bot: Auto-reminder scheduled in 48h for missing evidence.
Evan (FinOps): Drafting a provisional reversal plan if merchant supplies proof. Will need approvals: FinOps + Legal.
Marco (Risk): If merchant cannot prove intent, escalate to disputes/legal. Otherwise we attempt reversal and adjust ledger entries.
Asha (Billing): Uploading merchant documents and our evidence bundle to /shared/finance/dynads/evidence-dsp_77Yy by noon.
Legal Bot: Please loop in counsel if evidence includes conflicting timestamps or third-party delivery logs.
Asha (Billing): Will do. Posting updates here as they come in.
